automotive-ev-battery.title: EU: BEVs made up more than a quarter of new cars sold in August
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Battery-electric vehicles accounted for 27.7 percent of newly registered passenger cars in the EU during August, with plug-in hybrids adding another 11.1 percent for a combined market share of nearly 39 percent. The strong August performance demonstrates accelerating BEV adoption across the European market this year.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Geely counters BYD with 2.25 MW charging system
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Geely has launched a new generation of its Smart Charging technology capable of 2.25 megawatts, paired with batteries supporting up to 12C charging rates. The system enables vehicles to charge from 10 to 70 percent in approximately four and a half minutes, positioning Geely competitively in China's ultra-fast charging race.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Hyundai and LGES launch battery storage pilot using repurposed EV batteries
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Hyundai and Kia are collaborating with LG Energy Solution on a large-scale demonstration project that uses second-life EV batteries from the E-GMP platform as external storage buffers at charging stations. The initiative addresses grid infrastructure challenges while establishing a circular economy model for battery reuse.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Glut Of Chinese Plug-In Hybrids Threatens European Automakers
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Chinese manufacturers are increasingly prioritizing plug-in hybrid production in response to EU tariffs on battery-electric vehicles, creating a competitive threat to European automakers in the regional market. This strategic shift highlights how trade policies are reshaping the global EV landscape.

automotive-ev-battery.title: LA Metro Secures 220 New Battery-Electric Transit Buses
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Los Angeles Metro approved a purchase of 220 battery-electric buses, representing one of the largest electric transit bus acquisitions in the United States. The procurement more than doubles the agency's existing electric bus fleet and advances its commitment to achieving 100 percent zero-emission bus operations.

automotive-ev-battery.title: First drive in the Geely E2: an agile compact BEV with RWD and C-segment space
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The new Geely E2 compact BEV offers C-segment interior space with rear-wheel drive handling characteristics and a starting price of €19,990, directly challenging the B-segment market. The vehicle features multiple efficient powertrains and comprehensive equipment packages.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Efacec unveils charging hub solution with up to 1.6 MW
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Portuguese charging infrastructure manufacturer Efacec has introduced a modular charging hub platform accommodating up to 16 DC satellite chargers with total capacity reaching 1.6 megawatts. The integrated solution consolidates charging technology, software, and medium-voltage equipment into a single turnkey platform for charging parks.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Li Auto unveils new flagship BEV Li I9
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Chinese automaker Li Auto presented the all-electric Li i9, a 5.25-meter luxury SUV marking its largest battery-electric vehicle to date. The company is simultaneously preparing European market entry with the introduction of the Li 6 at the Paris Motor Show in October.

automotive-ev-battery.title: The Torcal: First all-electric Bentley enters the spotlight
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Bentley has unveiled the Torcal, its first all-electric vehicle, a luxury SUV built on the Volkswagen Group's PPE platform that shares battery and 800-volt architecture with the Porsche Cayenne. The ultra-luxury EV maintains Bentley's distinctive character while leveraging shared EV technology across the group.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Uruguay EV Sales Report: Sales Soar in August as Market Share Reaches 56%
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Uruguay's electric vehicle market share has surged to 56 percent in August, establishing the South American nation as a global EV adoption leader. The explosive growth significantly exceeds regional trends and surpasses previous market expectations for Latin American EV penetration.

science-space.title: NASA Shares SpaceX Crew-14 Assignments for Space Station Mission
science-space.summary: NASA has announced crew assignments for the SpaceX Crew-14 mission to the International Space Station, scheduled for no earlier than spring 2027. The four-member international crew includes NASA astronauts Kayla Barron and Chris Birch, JAXA astronaut Makoto Suwa, and a Roscosmos cosmonaut, representing a collaborative long-duration science expedition.

science-space.title: NASA Unveils Winning Designs for Mars Space Food Systems Challenge
science-space.summary: NASA announced the winners of the Deep Space Food Challenge: Mars to Table, with Chinyere Ukeje receiving the top $300,000 prize for her Adaptive Nourishment Infrastructure food system concept. The competition sought innovative solutions for providing safe, nutritious meals during long-duration Mars missions and deep space exploration.

science-space.title: NASA Welcomes Côte d'Ivoire as Newest Artemis Accords Signatory
science-space.summary: Côte d'Ivoire became the 75th signatory to the Artemis Accords, signing the agreement in Abidjan during a formal ceremony. The nation has committed to peaceful, transparent, and responsible exploration of the Moon, Mars, and beyond alongside other international partners.

science-space.title: Practicing for Safe Landings on the Moon and Beyond
science-space.summary: NASA researchers at Johnson Space Center have successfully tested the Safe and Precise Landing – Integrated Capabilities Evolution (SPLICE) system, an advanced guidance and navigation technology for lunar descent. The experiment, conducted using an Alta-X drone at Armstrong Flight Research Center, represents critical progress toward safe crewed landings on the Moon and beyond.

science-space.title: NASA to Study Human Health, Performance During Crew-13 Mission
science-space.summary: During NASA's SpaceX Crew-13 mission aboard the International Space Station, astronauts will participate in comprehensive biomedical and human performance investigations, including studies on how spaceflight affects blood flow and clotting. The mission will also evaluate methods to counter vision and brain changes while testing crew manual piloting capabilities.

science-space.title: US-India Satellite Captures Time-lapse Video of Volcanic Eruption
science-space.summary: The US-India NISAR satellite captured unprecedented time-lapse footage of a volcanic eruption on Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula, documenting lava spread from Krasheninnikov volcano following a nearby 8.8-magnitude earthquake in July 2025. This marks the first time the volcano has erupted in recorded history and demonstrates the satellite's capability for monitoring geological phenomena.

science-space.title: AlphaFold 'goes viral': database adds protein complexes of common viruses
science-space.summary: The AlphaFold protein database has been expanded to include structural predictions of protein complexes found in common viruses, significantly advancing virology research. This expansion enhances scientists' ability to understand viral mechanisms and develop targeted therapeutics and vaccines.

science-space.title: AI system helps lab devices 'talk' with each other — streamlining research
science-space.summary: A new artificial intelligence system enables laboratory instruments to communicate and coordinate autonomously, improving research efficiency and data integration. The technology represents a significant advancement in automating complex experimental workflows and reducing manual intervention in scientific research.

science-space.title: NASA's Machines for Mars Make Beer Bubbly
science-space.summary: Carbon-capture technology originally developed for Mars missions has been repurposed for brewery applications, demonstrating successful technology transfer. The innovation highlights how space exploration research yields practical commercial and industrial benefits on Earth.

science-space.title: APOD: 2026 September 24 – The Ghosts of Five Supernovas
science-space.summary: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day features an image and scientific explanation of supernova remnants visible in the night sky. The daily astronomy feature provides professional astronomical context for observing and understanding cosmic phenomena.

finance-markets.title: US long-term borrowing costs touch highest level since 2004
finance-markets.summary: US Treasury yields have reached their highest levels in two decades following a brutal sell-off in the bond market, placing significant strain on public finances. The surge reflects growing inflation concerns driven by geopolitical tensions and rising energy costs ahead of national elections.

finance-markets.title: US mortgage rates breach 7% as affordability pressures mount
finance-markets.summary: US mortgage rates have surpassed 7% as surging yields on government bonds and elevated oil prices fuel inflation expectations in the lead-up to national elections. The sharp increase in borrowing costs is intensifying affordability challenges for American homebuyers.

finance-markets.title: Surging US Yields Push Spreads With Asia Toward Extremes
finance-markets.summary: A dramatic surge in US Treasury yields has pushed yield differentials with emerging Asian bonds toward record levels, creating heightened risk of capital outflows from the region. The widening spreads reflect the global impact of US monetary policy on emerging markets.

finance-markets.title: Bonds Stabilize as Oil Declines, Stocks Edge Up: Markets Wrap
finance-markets.summary: Global bond markets showed signs of stabilization in Asia after an extended selloff that drove yields to multi-decade highs, with oil prices declining and offering investors some relief. The market recovery follows a bruising period for debt assets across global financial markets.

finance-markets.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for DATE
finance-markets.summary: Oil prices fell as negotiations between US and Iranian officials were reported to be exploring a phased ceasefire deal that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within a week. The potential easing of Middle East tensions offers prospects for relief in energy markets.

finance-markets.title: Gold Tilts Lower as Iran Impasse Continues to Fan Rate-Hike Bets
finance-markets.summary: Gold prices declined as elevated energy costs from Middle East tensions continue to reinforce expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates further to combat inflation. The weakness reflects market positioning on both energy and monetary policy risks.

finance-markets.title: India Lets Wealth-Focused Funds With $463 Billion Invest Abroad
finance-markets.summary: India's market regulator has granted $463 billion in wealth-management portfolio funds permission to invest in overseas securities and execute short selling strategies for the first time. The regulatory overhaul represents a significant liberalization of India's portfolio management industry.

finance-markets.title: Goldman reaped more than $200mn in fees from hedge fund Situational Awareness
finance-markets.summary: Goldman Sachs earned over $200 million in fees from AI-focused hedge fund Situational Awareness, which became the Wall Street bank's prime brokerage unit's largest client within just two years of its founding. The arrangement highlights the lucrative opportunities emerging from the artificial intelligence investment boom.

finance-markets.title: Kobayashi in $3.2 Billion Buyout Talks After Red-Yeast Case
finance-markets.summary: Japanese health products company Kobayashi Pharmaceutical, which faced a contamination scandal involving suspected deaths, is reportedly considering a private equity buyout offer exceeding ¥500 billion ($3.2 billion). The acquisition discussions mark a significant corporate development for the company seeking to recover from reputational damage.

finance-markets.title: AI Boom Can Withstand Higher Rates: Goldman's Moe
finance-markets.summary: Goldman Sachs' Chief Regional Equity Strategist for Asia Pacific argues that artificial intelligence-related stocks remain attractive investments despite rising government bond yields and elevated energy prices. His analysis suggests the AI sector possesses sufficient growth potential to offset headwinds from higher interest rates.

tech-ai.title: Waymo is scaling fast. Here's what the fleet data shows.
tech-ai.summary: Waymo has expanded its autonomous vehicle fleet in Texas by 49% over the past month, with additional growth occurring in other key markets. The expansion demonstrates accelerating commercial deployment of self-driving technology across multiple regions.

tech-ai.title: Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar gives Google's AI a face
tech-ai.summary: Google has released Gemini 3.8 Live with a new Live Avatar feature that displays an animated AI persona with real-time lip-syncing and facial expressions during conversations. The feature is currently available exclusively to Gemini Enterprise customers and supports transitions across 97 languages without visual degradation.

tech-ai.title: Muse will apparently let you download its entire filesystem
tech-ai.summary: Security researchers have discovered that Meta's Muse AI agent can be easily prompted to share its entire root filesystem, including Ubuntu system files and internal documentation, raising serious concerns about the application's security architecture. Meta has denied the severity of the incident, but independent developers confirmed the vulnerability requires minimal effort to exploit.

tech-ai.title: Meta is going to let you build games with AI right on your phone
tech-ai.summary: Meta has announced Horizon Create and Horizon Studio, new development tools that enable users to create games using AI prompts on mobile and browser platforms respectively. The tools aim to boost content creation for Meta's struggling Horizon social platform and are currently available in early access.

tech-ai.title: Oracle sends force majeure notice on its New Mexico Stargate data center
tech-ai.summary: Oracle has issued a force majeure notice regarding its New Mexico Stargate data center, which would permit the company to delay payments if the facility fails to meet its targeted 2028 online launch date. The notice signals potential complications in the major infrastructure project's timeline.

tech-ai.title: PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses
tech-ai.summary: PrismML has deployed its compact large language models on Qualcomm-powered smart glasses, advancing on-device AI processing capabilities. The move aligns with PrismML's broader mission to create open-weight AI systems that maximize the computing power already available in consumer hardware.

tech-ai.title: Meet Feather, the startup building the 'Android of robotics' for developers
tech-ai.summary: Feather has launched a customizable robotics platform priced at $30,000, targeting software developers seeking accessible, flexible robotic solutions. The startup aims to democratize robotics development similar to how Android transformed mobile software accessibility.

tech-ai.title: Databricks buys Row Zero and is scouting for more startups to acquire
tech-ai.summary: Databricks has acquired Row Zero, a cloud spreadsheet startup, continuing its aggressive acquisition strategy throughout 2026. The company is actively seeking additional startup targets to expand its platform capabilities.

tech-ai.title: Qualcomm's new 'Elite' sound chip might finally deliver the Wi-Fi earbud dream
tech-ai.summary: Qualcomm has introduced the Snapdragon Sound Elite Gen 2 chip, the first to integrate micro-power Wi-Fi 6E directly into the silicon, enabling wireless earbuds to stream high-quality lossless audio via home Wi-Fi without dependence on smartphone connectivity. The advancement addresses a longstanding promise to deliver reliable, interference-free wireless audio experiences.

tech-ai.title: Microsoft is killing off the 'Copilot Plus PC' brand
tech-ai.summary: Microsoft and Qualcomm are effectively discontinuing the 'Copilot Plus PC' branding initiative that was introduced two-and-a-half years ago to highlight AI-capable computers. The shift suggests the distinction between AI-ready and standard PCs has become commercially obsolete.

world-news.title: Trump-Xi summit: Four key takeaways from the Washington, DC, meeting
world-news.summary: U.S. President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping met at the White House to discuss stabilizing bilateral relations. Despite diplomatic engagement, significant differences persist over Iran, Taiwan, and trade policy, with no major resolutions announced.

world-news.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
world-news.summary: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faced walkouts during his address to the United Nations General Assembly, defending Israel's military operations while critics departed in protest. Netanyahu characterized those who left as "moral cowards."

world-news.title: Iran war live: Tehran wants Washington to re-enter MoU before US midterms
world-news.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian called for the United States to rejoin the nuclear agreement before early November, as tensions between Iran and the U.S. continue to escalate. The diplomatic overture comes amid broader geopolitical instability in the region.

world-news.title: UAE bars Iranian airlines as US sanctions squeeze Iran's aviation sector
world-news.summary: The United Arab Emirates joined five other regional countries in restricting Iranian airline access, responding to intensified U.S. sanctions targeting Iran's aviation industry. The coordinated action further isolates Iran's international connectivity.

world-news.title: Ethiopia's army says it has repelled attacks in first comment on fresh fighting
world-news.summary: Ethiopia's military reported successfully repelling recent attacks amid growing concerns of renewed civil war. The army's first public statement on the escalating conflict signals a potential resumption of full-scale hostilities.

world-news.title: Four civilians killed in Pakistani strikes in Afghanistan, Taliban says
world-news.summary: Pakistan conducted airstrikes in Afghanistan, resulting in four civilian deaths according to Taliban reports, though Pakistan claims all targets struck were military objectives. The incident highlights ongoing cross-border tensions between the two nations.

world-news.title: Argentina's poverty rises to 32 percent under Milei with more pain forecast
world-news.summary: Argentina's poverty rate reached 32 percent in the first half of 2026, representing a 4.1 percentage-point increase under President Javier Milei's administration. Economic analysts warn of further deterioration ahead, threatening Milei's political standing.

world-news.title: Italy ministers agree to ban burqa and niqab in school and cap foreigners in class
world-news.summary: Italy's government, led by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, approved measures banning face-covering religious garments in schools and imposing restrictions on foreign student enrollment. Officials framed the policies as integration tools rather than discriminatory measures.

world-news.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
world-news.summary: Australia announced a significant OpenAI security breach during a United Nations address, leveraging the global platform to highlight cybersecurity concerns. The disclosure comes as Australia pursues strict social media regulations and digital governance measures.

world-news.title: Costa Rica minister fired for unapproved meeting with Trump in US
world-news.summary: Costa Rica's President Fernandez dismissed the foreign minister over unauthorized attendance at a Trump-organized meeting in New York. The dismissal signals diplomatic tensions and questions over proper diplomatic protocol in inter-American relations.

crypto-web3.title: New York sues Polymarket, alleging it is running an illegal gambling operation
crypto-web3.summary: New York State has filed a lawsuit against prediction market platform Polymarket, claiming it operates as an unlicensed gambling service. The state seeks to block Polymarket's operations and recover allegedly illegal proceeds.

crypto-web3.title: U.S. Federal Reserve moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
crypto-web3.summary: The Federal Reserve has proposed regulatory rules to implement the GENIUS Act, including measures governing stablecoin yield programs and capital standards for stablecoin issuers. The proposal establishes comprehensive oversight for the rapidly growing stablecoin sector.

crypto-web3.title: Crypto exchange Bitget says $352 million affected in a hack, claims user funds are 'safe'
crypto-web3.summary: Bitget disclosed that approximately $352 million in assets were affected by a security breach following alerts from independent researchers about suspicious wallet movements. The exchange's leadership stated that user funds remain secure despite the incident.

crypto-web3.title: U.S. commodities firms can invest in tokenized assets, use blockchain records: CFTC
crypto-web3.summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has clarified that derivatives firms may invest in tokenized assets and utilize blockchain recordkeeping as standard industry practice. The regulatory guidance reflects the CFTC's ongoing efforts to integrate tokenization into mainstream derivatives operations.

crypto-web3.title: Bullish, Alpaca and Apex Fintech form coalition to push issuer-backed tokenized stocks
crypto-web3.summary: Three fintech firms have established a coalition to advance issuer-backed tokenized stock models following the SEC's innovation exemption for tokenized trading. The group aims to link onchain shares directly to official shareholder records.

crypto-web3.title: ARK Invest brings $1.3 billion venture fund onchain through Securitize
crypto-web3.summary: ARK Invest has tokenized its $1.3 billion ARK Venture Fund on Ethereum via Securitize, bringing a major institutional investment vehicle onchain for the first time. The fund holds significant positions in companies including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Stripe.

crypto-web3.title: Ondo launches onchain portfolio tokens based on BlackRock-developed strategies
crypto-web3.summary: Ondo Finance has launched three tokenized portfolio products based on model strategies developed by BlackRock, expanding the availability of institutional-grade investment vehicles on blockchain networks. The development reflects growing institutional adoption of onchain assets.

crypto-web3.title: Crypto casino Duelbits goes offline after $7 million hot wallet hack
crypto-web3.summary: Duelbits, a crypto casino platform, has taken offline following a security breach that drained approximately $7 million from hot wallets across multiple blockchains. Roughly $6 million in stolen funds currently remains consolidated in a single Ethereum address.

crypto-web3.title: HIFI raises $37 million Series A to expand tokenized capital markets infrastructure
crypto-web3.summary: HIFI has secured $37 million in Series A funding led by Left Lane Capital to scale its tokenized settlement infrastructure for capital markets. The funding will support the expansion of onchain mechanisms for institutional-grade financial transactions.

crypto-web3.title: Solana Foundation taps Binance, Polygon vets to drive institutional adoption and payments
crypto-web3.summary: Solana Foundation has appointed experienced executives from major crypto firms to leadership roles focused on institutional adoption and payments infrastructure. Rachel Conlan joins as chief strategy officer while Jamal Raees takes on governance of the payments division.

health-biotech.title: Kyverna's cell therapy shows lasting autoimmune benefit
health-biotech.summary: Kyverna Therapeutics has presented new clinical data demonstrating that its cell therapy for autoimmune disease maintains long-term efficacy, with many patients remaining off other therapies. The company is advancing toward launching what could be the first cell therapy approved for autoimmune conditions, representing a significant milestone in immunotherapy development.

health-biotech.title: FDA approves Eli Lilly's once-weekly insulin pen, setting up rivalry with Novo
health-biotech.summary: The FDA has approved Eli Lilly's Onswik, a once-weekly basal insulin injection for type 2 diabetes patients, offering a longer-acting alternative to daily insulin injections. The approval sets up direct competition with Novo Nordisk's existing insulin products in a significant market for diabetes management.

health-biotech.title: Kyverna says long-term data bolster FDA submission for rare autoimmune CAR-T
health-biotech.summary: Kyverna Therapeutics has reported positive one-year efficacy data for its CAR-T cell therapy in stiff person syndrome, a rare autoimmune disorder affecting approximately 6,000 U.S. patients. The long-term results strengthen the company's FDA submission for this innovative immunotherapy approach to treating autoimmune muscle disorders.

health-biotech.title: Elevar wins first FDA approval with second-line drug for bile duct cancer
health-biotech.summary: The FDA has approved Elevar Therapeutics' Lyrfigtu as a second-line treatment for bile duct cancer, a rare disease affecting approximately 8,000 Americans annually. This marks Elevar's first FDA approval and represents a new therapeutic option for patients with limited treatment alternatives.

health-biotech.title: One of the most contagious diseases on the planet is having its worst U.S. outbreak since 1991
health-biotech.summary: The United States is experiencing its worst measles outbreak since 1991, with four unvaccinated deaths reported in Pennsylvania alone and the CDC documenting a rising death toll. The resurgence of this highly contagious disease highlights ongoing vaccination gaps and public health concerns in vulnerable populations.

health-biotech.title: In another China pact, Lilly makes a deal with InnoCare worth up to $3.35B
health-biotech.summary: Eli Lilly has entered a partnership with Beijing-based InnoCare to develop new medicines, with potential deal value reaching up to $3.35 billion upon product commercialization. The agreement reflects Lilly's continued strategic expansion in China's drug discovery ecosystem.

health-biotech.title: Senate finance committee backs Chris Klomp, advancing him to full Senate vote
health-biotech.summary: The Senate Finance Committee has advanced Chris Klomp's nomination to a full Senate vote for the position of HHS Deputy Secretary under RFK Jr. Klomp, a behind-the-scenes HHS policy figure, is expected to play a significant role in health policy implementation.

health-biotech.title: Indonesian ruling against 'patent evergreening' by pharma industry sends critical message, patient advocates say
health-biotech.summary: An Indonesian court has ruled against pharmaceutical industry practices of patent evergreening, a strategy used to extend patent protections on existing drugs. Patient advocates view the decision as a significant precedent that may encourage other countries to challenge similar practices and improve drug access.

health-biotech.title: Merck's return to ophthalmology snags first success
health-biotech.summary: Merck's $1.3 billion investment in EyeBio is yielding results with an efficacy win in an ophthalmology program, though analysts have raised questions about safety data from the pivotal trial. The development marks Merck's re-entry into the ophthalmology space with clinical validation.

health-biotech.title: Why Gilead can't stop talking about its ambitions in immunology
health-biotech.summary: Gilead Sciences executives have emphasized the company's strategic focus on developing drugs for inflammatory and autoimmune diseases as a key growth area. The biotech's multi-year immunology push reflects significant corporate commitment to this therapeutic space.

startups-vc.title: Databricks buys Row Zero and is scouting for more startups to acquire
startups-vc.summary: Databricks has acquired cloud spreadsheet startup Row Zero as part of an active 2026 acquisition strategy. The deal signals continued consolidation in the data analytics and productivity software space as established players expand their platforms.

startups-vc.title: The Week's 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Large Rounds For AI Infrastructure, Space Tech And Investment Management Lead
startups-vc.summary: Major U.S. startups secured hundreds of millions in funding this week, with Temporal Technologies leading at $550 million for AI infrastructure and Impulse Space raising $308 million for space vehicle development. The funding landscape shows diversification across AI, space tech, and fintech sectors.

startups-vc.title: Stripe's AI CRO on the Fastest-Growing AI Companies: 175% Growth, 48% of Revenue From Outside the Home Market, and Agents About to Read More Stripe Docs Than Human
startups-vc.summary: Stripe's Chief Revenue Officer of AI shared insights from the platform's unique vantage point processing payments for the world's fastest-growing AI companies, revealing 175% median growth rates and significant international revenue diversification. The data underscores the explosive momentum in the AI sector and changing dynamics around AI agents.

startups-vc.title: Exclusive: From Booking Calls To Late Check-Ins, Dextr AI Raises $6.7M For Hotel AI Agents
startups-vc.summary: Dextr AI emerged from stealth with $6.7 million in seed funding to develop AI agents that automate hotel operations including reservations, guest requests, and staff coordination. The funding validates growing investor appetite for vertical-specific AI agent applications.

startups-vc.title: What 25,000 Startup Applications Reveal About The New Rules Of Seed-Stage Startups
startups-vc.summary: Analysis of 25,000 seed-stage startup applications reveals that the most fundable companies prioritize clear go-to-market strategies and test distinctive distribution channels early, treating focused execution and AI as core infrastructure. The research provides data-driven insights into what separates successful seed-stage companies from their peers.

startups-vc.title: Gaming Startup Funding Levels Up A Bit In 2026
startups-vc.summary: Gaming industry startups have raised approximately $2 billion in seed through growth-stage funding so far in 2026, already exceeding the full-year 2025 total. Growth is being driven significantly by companies at the intersection of AI and gaming.

startups-vc.title: Ando wants to take on Slack with a team messaging app that lets humans and agents work together
startups-vc.summary: Ando is launching a team messaging platform designed to compete with Slack by enabling seamless collaboration between human employees and AI agents, with agents having their own identities and inboxes. The startup represents a new generation of productivity tools built for hybrid human-AI workflows.

startups-vc.title: Meet Feather, the startup building the 'Android of robotics' for developers
startups-vc.summary: Feather is developing a customizable $30,000 robotics platform specifically designed for software developers, positioning itself as a flexible alternative to proprietary systems. The approach aims to democratize robotics development by providing an open, developer-friendly foundation.

startups-vc.title: PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses
startups-vc.summary: PrismML is deploying its lightweight large language models on Qualcomm-powered smart glasses, enabling on-device AI without requiring cloud connectivity. The startup's approach targets more efficient use of existing computing power in consumer hardware.

startups-vc.title: Nexterity wants to automate the hard, dangerous part of pipefitting
startups-vc.summary: Nexterity has developed a specialized robot capable of tightening or loosening four bolts simultaneously in pipefitting operations, packaged in a portable Pelican case for field deployment. The startup addresses workplace safety and labor efficiency in industrial maintenance.

cybersecurity.title: Microsoft Patches a Record 570 Security Flaws
cybersecurity.summary: Microsoft released software updates addressing at least 570 security vulnerabilities across Windows and other products, nearly triple the previous month's record-breaking count. The company attributes the surge in discovered flaws to advances in artificial intelligence-aided vulnerability detection.

cybersecurity.title: 17,000 URLs Reveal How ClickFix Turns Trusted Websites Into Malware Traps
cybersecurity.summary: A comprehensive threat report documents ClickFix's evolution from a novel technique in late 2023 to a subscription-based malware distribution service with state-sponsored users affecting enterprise networks. The analysis of 17,000 URLs reveals that ClickFix operates without exploits, attachments, or disk files, making traditional domain-blocking defenses ineffective.

cybersecurity.title: Secrets Sprawl Is an Identity Problem That AI Just Made Impossible to Ignore
cybersecurity.summary: According to GitGuardian's 2026 State of Secrets Sprawl Report, AI-assisted code commits are leaking secrets at approximately twice the rate of human-written code. The fastest-growing categories of leaked credentials are increasingly connected to AI development tools.

cybersecurity.title: Unpatched OnePlus Flaws Let Installed Android Apps Gain Root Without Permissions
cybersecurity.summary: Researcher Rasmus Moorats discovered unpatched vulnerabilities in OnePlus devices that allow malicious applications to gain root access without requiring any special permissions. OnePlus confirmed the same flaws affect multiple devices across its own line and devices from partner manufacturer OPPO.

cybersecurity.title: Read This Before You Buy That TV Streaming Stick
cybersecurity.summary: A new analysis reveals that generic TV streaming devices not only secretly rent users' internet connections to third parties but also spoof themselves as mobile phones to commit ad fraud against merchants and advertising networks. Security experts have long warned about the risks of these devices, but this research uncovers previously undocumented malicious activity.

cybersecurity.title: TeamFiltration Campaign Compromises Seven Microsoft 365 Accounts Using Default Passwords
cybersecurity.summary: Researchers have disclosed details of an active TeamFiltration campaign that has targeted over 5,700 accounts across 28 Microsoft 365 tenants, primarily affecting Chilean retail and financial institutions. The campaign, originating from 1,487 unique AWS EC2 addresses, successfully compromised accounts using default password attacks.

cybersecurity.title: Attackers Exploit WordPress CVE-2026-87902 Within Hours of Disclosure
cybersecurity.summary: Threat actors began actively exploiting a critical WordPress vulnerability (CVE-2026-87902, CVSS 9.2) within hours of public disclosure, enabling unauthenticated remote code execution. The flaw allows attackers to manipulate the get_page_template() function to include arbitrary local PHP files.

cybersecurity.title: Hacked Ukrainian Sites Serve Fake Cloudflare ClickFix Lures for Psychedelic Stealer
cybersecurity.summary: An active ClickFix campaign has compromised legitimate Ukrainian business websites to inject fake Cloudflare verification pages designed to trick victims into downloading Psychedelic, a previously undocumented information stealer. The malware uses social engineering to copy Windows Installer commands to victims' clipboards for execution.

cybersecurity.title: LG to Ban Residential Proxies from Smart TV Apps
cybersecurity.summary: LG Electronics USA announced it will suspend apps from its webOS store that convert televisions into residential proxy nodes after researchers found over 42 percent of available games and apps allow unknown third parties to route internet traffic through users' devices. The move addresses widespread abuse of smart TV infrastructure for illicit purposes.

cybersecurity.title: Corp MDM Spyware Targets Logistics Firms, Steals SMS and Redirects Calls
cybersecurity.summary: The logistics sector has become the target of a new Android spyware campaign distributing malware codenamed Corp MDM through fake Google Play pages impersonating CEVA and TKW Logistics. The APK disguises itself as a system service and enables attackers to intercept SMS messages and redirect calls.

energy-climate.title: Interactive: What China's dozens of 'five-year plans' say about climate and energy
energy-climate.summary: Nearly three-quarters of China's 72 five-year plans published this year include policies or targets related to climate change and energy transition. This comprehensive analysis demonstrates China's integration of climate action across multiple sectors and governance levels.

energy-climate.title: CCC: Heathrow expansion could push flights to '80% of UK emissions by 2050'
energy-climate.summary: The UK's Climate Change Committee warns that aviation could account for 80% of the nation's carbon dioxide emissions by 2050 if Heathrow expands as planned. This projection highlights the climate risks of airport expansion amid broader efforts to decarbonize the economy.

energy-climate.title: Analysis: EVs are now nine times cheaper than petrol or diesel to drive in the UK
energy-climate.summary: Electric vehicles have become significantly more cost-competitive, with recent fossil fuel price surges making them up to nine times cheaper to operate than petrol or diesel vehicles in the UK. This analysis underscores the growing economic case for EV adoption in the transport sector.

energy-climate.title: Spain plans to allocate 11 GW of grid capacity for renewables, storage
energy-climate.summary: Spain is planning to dedicate up to 11 GW of grid capacity to renewable energy and storage projects, with targeted tenders for pumped-hydro developments in key regions. This initiative reflects Europe's commitment to expanding renewable infrastructure and grid modernization.

energy-climate.title: Websol secures land for 4 GW solar cell and module factory in India
energy-climate.summary: Websol Energy System has acquired 21.9 hectares in West Bengal to develop a 4 GW solar manufacturing facility, to be built in two 2 GW phases. This expansion signals India's growing capacity in domestic solar production to support its renewable energy targets.

energy-climate.title: Pylontech starts mass production of 588 Ah, 601 Ah storage cells
energy-climate.summary: Chinese battery manufacturer Pylontech has commenced volume production of large-format lithium iron phosphate cells for utility-scale energy storage applications. This development expands domestic battery supply capacity for grid-scale storage projects.

energy-climate.title: Brazil power producers call for BESS framework and curtailment rules
energy-climate.summary: Brazil's independent power producers are advocating for a regulatory framework for battery energy storage systems and the nation's first storage auction, alongside clearer renewable energy curtailment guidelines. This call reflects the growing need for energy storage infrastructure as renewables expand in Brazil's grid.

energy-climate.title: Ventilator exhaust air, evaporative cooling boost residential heat pump efficiency
energy-climate.summary: South Korean researchers have developed an enhanced residential air-source heat pump that integrates energy recovery ventilator exhaust air with direct evaporative cooling, achieving efficiency improvements of 7.3% to 15.2% in hot, humid conditions. This innovation offers potential for retrofitting existing heat pump systems to improve heating performance.

energy-climate.title: NorthStar Clean Energy completes 120MW Hart Solar Project in US
energy-climate.summary: NorthStar Clean Energy has completed the 120 MW Hart Solar Project in Michigan and begun operations. This project adds utility-scale capacity to the growing U.S. solar portfolio.

energy-climate.title: Zambia commissions 100 MW solar project
energy-climate.summary: Zambia has commissioned the 100 MW Maamba solar project developed by a Nava Limited subsidiary, with a 20-year power purchase agreement at a competitive tariff of $0.078/kWh. This project supports Zambia's renewable energy expansion and energy access objectives.

asia-pacific.title: How was dinner? Takeaways from Xi and Trump's evening at the White House
asia-pacific.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Donald Trump held their second face-to-face meeting this year at the White House, addressing top American business executives and officials before a state dinner. The leaders discussed critical bilateral issues including Taiwan and the Middle East, with Trump characterizing the meeting as productive and emphasizing deeper cooperation between the two nations.

asia-pacific.title: Takaichi's Pre-emptive Diplomacy: What Japan Needs From the Trump-Xi Summit
asia-pacific.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi proactively communicated Tokyo's strategic concerns to President Trump ahead of his summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Japan seeks to ensure its interests are reflected in U.S.-China negotiations given the regional implications of bilateral agreements on trade, security, and technological issues.

asia-pacific.title: Delivered to the Wrong Address? F-35 Parts Re-routed to Hong Kong
asia-pacific.summary: Advanced F-35 fighter aircraft components with significant proprietary value were inadvertently rerouted to Hong Kong, raising serious concerns about potential access by foreign intelligence services and highlighting supply chain vulnerabilities in sensitive defense technology. The incident underscores the risks of treating cutting-edge military systems as standard consumer products in global logistics networks.

asia-pacific.title: Ukraine's POW transfer reveal deals North Korea a propaganda blow
asia-pacific.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky publicly disclosed that Kyiv recently transferred two North Korean prisoners of war to South Korea, directly undermining Pyongyang's narrative that its soldiers fighting alongside Russian forces prefer death over capture. The revelation has propaganda implications for North Korea's military morale and international standing regarding its involvement in the Russia-Ukraine conflict.

asia-pacific.title: India's Semiconductor Journey: Old Designer, New Producer
asia-pacific.summary: India possesses substantial semiconductor design talent but faces challenges in transitioning this capability into domestically-owned companies and establishing a robust supplier base to support domestic fabrication facilities. Bridging this gap is critical for India's ambitions to become a global semiconductor manufacturing hub and reduce dependence on foreign supply chains.

asia-pacific.title: From ping-pong to pickleball: China's unofficial approach to diplomatic messaging
asia-pacific.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping responded to correspondence from students at ten U.S. universities, including Harvard, who participated in exchange programs to China, calling for deeper bilateral cooperation. The gesture exemplifies Beijing's longstanding practice of leveraging unofficial channels—from academic exchanges to sports diplomacy—to advance its diplomatic objectives with the United States.

asia-pacific.title: Grand Strategic Compatibility: The Basis of The Japan-Vietnam Partnership
asia-pacific.summary: Japan and Vietnam have achieved rapid reconciliation and strengthened partnership since the Cold War's end, driven by compatibility in their respective grand strategic interests and regional security concerns. The alignment reflects both nations' commitment to maintaining a rules-based international order and countering regional hegemonic pressures.

asia-pacific.title: Constitutional Reform as the Lee Jae-myung Administration's Political Watershed
asia-pacific.summary: South Korean political discourse increasingly focuses on constitutional reform regarding the presidency structure, with potential changes under consideration by the current administration. Such reforms could represent a significant watershed moment in South Korea's political system and governance framework.

asia-pacific.title: How Hong Kong is remapping the future of higher education
asia-pacific.summary: Hong Kong's inaugural five-year development plan represents a major governance milestone, incorporating input from 16,000 public submissions to chart long-term economic and social development. The plan demonstrates an unprecedented alignment of public consensus and political will, marking a shift from the city's traditional market-oriented approach toward strategic government planning.

asia-pacific.title: Burmese Refugees in Thailand Face Fresh Deportation Threat
asia-pacific.summary: A newly-enacted Thai law significantly increases risks for Burmese refugees by threatening deportation and forced military recruitment into Myanmar's military units designated as 'one-way troops.' The policy development raises serious humanitarian concerns regarding the safety and protection of displaced persons fleeing military repression in Myanmar.
